historical_rights.title: Historical boundaries of world countries and cultural regions
historical_rights.retention: Retain exact pinned GeoJSON and metadata bytes plus GPL-3.0 text. Preserve source identification and notices in derivative data packages.
historical_rights.modification_notice: Chronicle applies classification, deterministic cell intersection and independent cultural/source-political-association views; these are Chronicle transformations of the pinned source. Original geometry bytes remain separate.
historical_rights.authorization: User authorized bounded collection, normalization, classification, staged ingestion, compilation and local preview on this turn; historical/public publication remains unapproved.
historical_rights.scholarly_status: Source-attributed overview reconstruction. Source author requests independent verification for academic use. Classification of label semantics is not historical certification.
prohibited_inferences: No index country label alone establishes sovereignty.
No PARTOF cultural region becomes a political relationship.
No SUBJECTO self-label or colonial-power label silently becomes source-independent control.
No guessed corroborating evidence or source-feature historical precision.
historical_rights.spatial_precision: Continental/global scale; preserve BORDERPRECISION ordinal1approximate,2moderate,3source-described legal boundary as source metadata, not Chronicle certification. Source acknowledges possible20km shifts.
historical_rights.temporal_precision: Snapshot filename/index gives nominal historical year; convert BCE to internal astronomical numbering. Coarse and uncertain snapshot meaning must survive ingestion; calendar-year envelope is not exact dated events.
historical_rights.lineage_limitations: README credits diverse compiled sources and anonymous ThinkQuest Team C006628 material. Individual feature source citations are generally absent; no independent source-original documentary authentication is claimed.

physical_source.title: Natural Earth 1:50m physical land
physical_source.attribution: Made with Natural Earth. Free vector and raster map data @ naturalearthdata.com.
physical_source.version_discrepancy: The official landing page advertises 4.0.0; the exact downloaded archive declares 4.1.0. This intake pins the archive edition and SHA-256 before processing. The frozen resource limits are unchanged.
physical_source.interpretation: Complete modern physical land context; not historical shoreline evidence or political ownership. Full source coordinates retained, with display-only latitude clamp at Web Mercator limits and deterministic ten-component MultiPolygon grouping. No source component omitted.

mapping: Reuse pinned basemap-classification-v2: political-association only; review/excluded rows remain explicit omissions. NAME does not independently establish sovereignty. Preserve SUBJECTO/PARTOF as raw source fields without inferring control. Shared UK, France and Belgium identities and colors copied from existing Isles1900 scene; other identities derive from exact source NAME.
temporal_interpretation: Nominal1900 snapshot; calendar-year possible observation envelope [1900-01-01,1901-01-01), not exact onset/cessation or daily continuity. No carry-forward as historical validity.
geometry: Original source polygons directly supply a separate display product. Validate topology; quarantine any invalid feature rather than silently repair. Cartographic MVT simplification by zoom only. Canvas political fallback retains original coordinates and holes. No interpolation or smoothing.
quarantined_hawaii: UNCHANGED; no Hawaiʻi/Hawaii/Hawaiian entity admitted or promoted.
